violations.text: Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (can opener, slicer, ice machine) were observed with an accumulation debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Ice machines were emptied at the time of inspection. Slicer was taken apart to be washed, rinsed, and sanitized. Can opener was placed in dish machine. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 09/01/2026

Fish/seafood was observed held between 44-47 degrees Fahrenheit in the upstairs grill draw. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Product above 45 degrees was voluntarily disposed of at the time of inspection. Unit was observed to be turned off. Unit turned back on and observed holding an ambient of 38 DF. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/01/2026

Various food was observed held between 44-48 degrees Fahrenheit in the left side of the cook line prep unit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. All food was recently stocked into prep unit and moved to the walk-in cooler at the time of inspection. All food in right side of unit was observed at 41 DF or lower. Establishment is not to store any TCS foods in the left side of prep unit until it is able to hold an ambient temperature of 41 DF or less. Per PIC, service will be called. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/01/2026

Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Potatoes and noodles were observed placed into prep units in covered containers before being properly cooled. Proper cooling methods reviewed with PIC. Product was uncovered. PIC elected disposal of potatoes. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/01/2026

The presence of small flies is not controlled as evidenced by live activity in the upstairs bar. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. Establishment is to continue to work with pest control to eliminate small flies. New Violation. Correct By: 09/01/2026

Bowls are being used as scoops in containers of pasta. Utensils used to dispense non-time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods such as sugar and flour must be stored in the food item with their handles above the top of the food within the container. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/01/2026

Knife was observed being stored in between the prep-unit and prep table. Knife was moved to ware washing area at the time of inspection. Proper utensil storage reviewed with PIC. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/01/2026

The floor in the dry storage area has an accumulation of soil residue, droppings, and food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 09/01/2026

Soap was not available at a hand-washing sink in the upstairs kitchen. Hand-washing sinks must be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap. Soap was provided at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/19/2025

Raw animal foods were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods in the various refrigeration. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Foods were rearranged for proper storage at the time of inspection Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/19/2025

The chlorine sanitizer concentration for the sanitizing cycle of the dishwashers at the upstairs bars was less than 50 parts per million (ppm). Chlorine sanitizing solutions must be between 50-100 ppm. Per the PIC, glasses are to be washed/rinsed/sanitized at kitchen dish machine until units adjusted/repaired. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/19/2025

Several items held in the first-floor kitchen hot hold unit were observed not properly reheated to 165 degrees Fahrenheit prior to hot holding. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food that is cooked, cooled, and reheated for hot holding must be reheated to 165 degrees Fahrenheit or above for 15 seconds. Food items were properly reheated at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/19/2025

Several items prepped on site were observed held beyond seven days from the date of preparation marked on the item... - Garlic Aioli 7-29-25 - Dill Aioli 8-5-25 - Caesar Dressing 8-11-25 - House Dressing 7-9-25 Dressings were voluntarily disposed of by the PIC at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/19/2025

Working spray bottle containers used for storing chemicals taken from bulk supplies were not marked with the common name of the chemical. Name of chemicals were added at time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/19/2025

Frozen Reduced Oxygen Packaged Lobster was observed thawing in standing water in the food prep sink. ROP Lobster was observed at 32 degrees Fahrenheit and removed from packaging at the time of inspection. Proper thawing was reviewed at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/19/2025

The following equipment was observed to be in need of repair/adjustment... - Tubing to the dish machine at the outdoor rooftop deck was observed to be broken/cracked not allowing for proper sanitizing during the rinse cycle. Tubing is to be replaced. - The pressure gauge to the first-floor kitchen dish washer was observed improperly working during the rinse cycle (Shifting to below 0 psi when rinse cycle began). Pressure gauge is to read 15 to 25 psi. - The cold water to the upstairs kitchen hand sink was observed to be turned off (per PIC due to a leak). Equipment is to be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 09/02/2025
Pasta and calamari dressing were observed held past their seven day date marking. PIC voluntarily disposed of food at time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 02/08/2024

The floor in the second floor kitchen area had an accumulation of old rodent droppings. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 02/08/2024
